minutes.headline: Committee voted 5-1 to move the west wing parking up to the existing walkway and remove the trees
minutes.summary: The TC Passios building design committee reviewed an updated civil site plan, a loading dock request, bathroom labeling, and owner-furnished and soft-cost items for the estimate. It voted to direct the engineers on west wing parking and approved two sets of minutes. Other items, such as the loading dock ramp, sliding windows and the commercial kitchen, were left for sketches or alternates.

public_comment.stated_role: chair of the public access cable committee, 227 Pleasant Street
public_comment.topic: Asked that PAC get an outside door matching the others with card access, a monitor by its corridor entrance, and a loading dock, and asked to join any discussion.
Questioned the purpose of a public outreach forum held close to Town Meeting, since feedback would be hard to act on.

votes.motion: Instruct the engineers to remove the trees and move the west wing parking lot up to the existing walkway, with other necessary changes.
Approve the minutes as presented for November 30th and December 14th.

budget_items.topic: West wing parking and sidewalk layout
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said sliding the parking toward the building might save cost by reducing the slope and retaining wall. Replacement trees were said to cost little.
The architects are building the estimate with hard and soft costs and need a design start date to calculate escalation to the midpoint of construction. August was agreed as the assumed design start.
The architect said loading docks are expensive and a ramp would add cost. Members preferred a sketch of a ramp alternative.
Members agreed to price sliding windows as an add alternate while the base stays fixed windows.
The architect estimated outfitting the kitchen from a comparable project. The committee leaned toward installing infrastructure only.
A member noted a bond bill for a commercial kitchen is unreleased and unrequested.
Furniture, AV, security, signage and office furniture were discussed for the budget. Pricing is to come from PAC, the facilities director and local vendors.

decisions.decision: The architect will ask the civil engineer whether pads at the west wing doors can replace the walkways, and will report back, with an email vote possible.
The chair will ask the DPW director, who is tree warden, about the condition of the trees.
The committee agreed to assume an August design start for escalation purposes.
The architect will sketch a ramp option at the public stairs and check ADA needs, to be sent before the next meeting.
A PAC van garage space was left unresolved for now.
The committee agreed on standardized hard flooring (LVT, with VCT as an alternate in offices).
Sliding windows to be priced as an add alternate with fixed windows as the base.
No portable stage; new tables and chairs for meeting rooms one and three.
Remove all lead paint, and the chimney, as part of the project.
Next meeting set for the 27th; further schedule to be set in February.
Two single bathrooms near the administrative wing to be labeled staff; the large bathrooms to be general public.

what_happened.line: The building design committee voted 5-1 to instruct the engineers to remove trees and move the west wing parking up to the existing walkway.
The architects need a design start date to estimate escalation, and the committee agreed to assume August.
The architect will sketch a ramp option at the public stairs and check ADA needs, to be sent before the next meeting.
The committee chose standardized hard flooring, and agreed to price sliding transaction windows as an add alternate with fixed windows as the base.
The committee agreed the project will include removing all lead paint and the chimney; the next meeting is set for the 27th.

why_it_matters: The parking layout, the loading dock, the kitchen and the hazardous-material work all feed the construction estimate, which sets the cost a future Town Meeting vote on the building would be asked to fund.
